ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in Australia shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.10): the estimate is −0.51 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −1.14 to +0.10). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in Australia shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.26): the estimate is +0.058 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.041 to +0.158). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in Australia shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.46): the estimate is +0.025 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.041 to +0.094). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
